description: This file defines the EventEditFragment class, a DialogFragment used for creating or editing calendar events within the Android application. It handles UI elements for event details and triggers API calls to persist the data.

classes.name: EventEditFragment
classes.description: A DialogFragment that presents a form for creating or editing a calendar event, including UI setup and API integration.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of EventEditFragment with an optional Event argument.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns the dialog UI for editing or creating an event, setting up input fields and the save button's click listener.
